basic_details.job_title: DMHO Yadadri Bhuvanagiri Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 18 Staff Nurse, ANM and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Office of the District Medical and Health Officer, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri District, Telangana, is filling 18 posts under the National Health Mission (NHM): 13 Staff Nurse, 2 ANM and one post each of VCCM, Physician and Radiographer. Monthly salary ranges from Rs. 19,500 to Rs. 52,000 depending on the post. The application form is downloaded from yadadri.telangana.gov.in and submitted in person-ready paper form at G-17, IDOC, Raigir, between 17 November 2026, 10:30 AM and 19 November 2026, 5.00 PM.

qualification.details: SSC, and (18) months MPHW(F) training certificate recognized by the Telangana State Nursing and Midwifes council, OR two (02) years Intermediate vocational MPHW(F) course and completed one-year clinical training in a selected govt hospital in which these students have been permitted to undergo clinical training, or completed one year apprenticeship training in identified hospitals and awarded apprenticeship completion certificate by the board of apprenticeship training GOI. | Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility of each post.

how_to_apply: Applications are made offline using the form published by the district. The notice gives these steps:
Download the Application Form and Guidelines from the official website of Yadadri Bhuvanagiri District, https://yadadri.telangana.gov.in.
Fill in the downloaded application form.
Enclose the required copies of certificates.
Submit the application at G-17, IDOC, Raigir, O/o District Medical & Health Officer, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri District.
Submit it between 17-11-2026, 10:30 AM and 19-11-2026, 5.00 PM.
The notice does not mention whether applications may be sent by post. The Guidelines published with the form on the district website may give further instructions.
The filled application form downloaded from the district website

content_sections.heading: About DMHO Yadadri Bhuvanagiri Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The District Medical and Health Officer is the district health office of Yadadri Bhuvanagiri District in Telangana, working from G-17, IDOC, Raigir. These 18 posts are filled under the National Health Mission in the district. The notification states that it has the approval of the Collector and District Magistrate, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri District.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notification lists 18 vacancies across five posts. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up. The notice states the salary as a monthly amount for each post. It does not mention allowances or the tenure of the posts.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notification lists the educational qualification for each post as below. It does not mention experience or an age limit for any post. SSC, and (18) months MPHW(F) training certificate recognized by the Telangana State Nursing and Midwifes council, OR two (02) years Intermediate vocational MPHW(F) course and completed one-year clinical training in a selected govt hospital in which these students have been permitted to undergo clinical training, or completed one year apprenticeship training in identified hospitals and awarded apprenticeship completion certificate by the board of apprenticeship training GOI. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility of each post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DMHO Yadadri Bhuvanagiri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 18 vacancies: 13 Staff Nurse, 2 ANM, and 1 each of VCCM, Physician and Radiographer.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of application is 19 November 2026, 5.00 PM. Applications start on 17 November 2026 at 10:30 AM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: Staff Nurse candidates need BSC (Nursing)/GNM and must be registered with the TG Nursing council.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the ANM post?
faq.answer: ANM candidates need SSC with an 18-month MPHW(F) training certificate recognized by the Telangana State Nursing and Midwifes council, or a two-year Intermediate vocational MPHW(F) course with one-year clinical training or one-year apprenticeship training as stated in the notice.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for each post?
faq.answer: The monthly salary is Rs. 19,500 for VCCM, Rs. 27,300 for ANM, Rs. 29,900 for Staff Nurse, Rs. 52000 for Physician and Rs. 22750 for Radiographer.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for DMHO Yadadri Bhuvanagiri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Download the Application Form and Guidelines from https://yadadri.telangana.gov.in, fill it, enclose the required copies of certificates and submit it at G-17, IDOC, Raigir, O/o District Medical & Health Officer, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri District.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for the Physician post?
faq.answer: The Physician post requires MBBS and registration with the TG Medical Council.

faq.question: Q8. Under which programme are these posts filled?
faq.answer: All 18 posts are under the National Health Mission (NHM) in Yadadri Bhuvanagiri District, Telangana.
